title: Videogame Record
description: Schema representing a single videogame entry.

genres.description: List of genres the game belongs to

platform.description: Primary release platform (e.g., PlayStation, PC, Xbox, Switch)

criticScore.description: Critic score for the videogame (typically 0–10, 0–100, etc.)

userScore.description: User score for the videogame (typically 0–10, 0–100, etc.)

ESRB.description: ESRB age rating for the videogame (e.g., E, T, M)

globalSales.description: Total global sales in millions of units

series.description: Franchise or series the game belongs to
